labels.structure: Verified: passes, order, render targets, programs, draw state, uniform values, cameras and model matrices are read from the recording
labels.roles: Inferred: each pass's role (simulation, bloom, composite...) is DEA's reading of it
labels.shaders: the site's own GLSL as the browser compiled it, one file per program (edit them)
labels.geometry: recorded: vertex and index buffers are the bytes the site uploaded (resources.buffers -> data)
labels.textures: recorded: texture pixels and the starting state of render targets are the bytes read back from the GPU (resources.textures -> data)
labels.raw: steps with op "gl" are WebGL calls three.js has no word for, run as recorded on the pipeline objects
